title: Epilepsy Fellowship
Department: Department of Neurology, Mayo Clinic School of Graduate Medical Education
Duration: 1 year (2-year option combined with the Clinical Neurophysiology EEG fellowship)
Deadline: January of the year preceding the start date
Eligibility: Enrolled in or completed an accredited adult or child neurology residency in the United States or Canada
International applicants: Open to international applicants; graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification before appointment
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited; graduates eligible for ABPN epilepsy subspecialty certification
Application method: ERAS application with three letters of recommendation; appointment through the NRMP Match; interviews January–March
Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)
Visa support: ECFMG J-1 and H-1B visa sponsorship will be considered (programme page)
Licence requirement: Fellows must obtain and maintain an appropriate medical licence while enrolled
Summary: A one-year ACGME epilepsy fellowship in Rochester providing advanced training in EEG, video-EEG, intracranial recordings and adult and paediatric epilepsy management with protected research time.

title: Vascular Neurology Fellowship
Department: Department of Neurology, Mayo Clinic School of Graduate Medical Education
Deadline: January 15, approximately 18 months before the start date
Eligibility: Completion of an accredited neurology or physical medicine residency in the United States or Canada
International applicants: Open to international applicants; graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification before appointment
Application method: ERAS application; appointments through the Vascular Neurology Match (NRMP); interviews January–March by invitation
Positions: Page states two positions in one section and one position offered annually in another — confirm with programme
Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)
Visa support: Mayo Clinic supports ECFMG J-1 and H-1B sponsorship (J-1 requires an ACGME-accredited/recognised programme; no new H-1B petitions requiring the US$100,000 payment); final visa type at Mayo's discretion
Licence requirement: Fellows must obtain and maintain an appropriate medical licence while enrolled
Summary: A one-year ACGME fellowship in Rochester training neurologists in the evaluation, diagnosis and management of stroke and all types of cerebrovascular disorders.

title: Movement Disorders Fellowship
Department: Department of Neurology, Mayo Clinic School of Graduate Medical Education
Duration: 1 year (a second year may be considered)
Eligibility: Completion of an accredited neurology or physical medicine residency; qualified to take the ABPN certifying examination
International applicants: Open to international applicants; graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification before appointment
Application method: Online application via Mayo's Recruit system; no matching program; interviews April–June
Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)
Visa support: Mayo Clinic supports ECFMG J-1 and H-1B sponsorship (J-1 requires an ACGME-accredited/recognised programme; no new H-1B petitions requiring the US$100,000 payment); final visa type at Mayo's discretion
Licence requirement: Fellows must obtain and maintain an appropriate medical licence while enrolled
Summary: A one-year clinical and research fellowship in Rochester offering multidisciplinary training in the diagnosis and treatment of movement disorders, including surgical and genetic advances.

title: Headache Fellowship
Department: Department of Neurology, Mayo Clinic School of Graduate Medical Education
Deadline: April 15 of the year preceding the start date (priority review)
Eligibility: Completion of an accredited four-year neurology residency and ABPN board eligibility
International applicants: Open to international applicants; graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification before appointment
Accreditation: UCNS-accredited; eligible for UCNS Headache Medicine certification
Application method: Online application via Mayo's Recruit system plus NRMP Match registration; three letters of recommendation (one from residency programme director or chair)
Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)
Visa support: Mayo Clinic supports ECFMG J-1 and H-1B sponsorship (J-1 requires an ACGME-accredited/recognised programme; no new H-1B petitions requiring the US$100,000 payment); final visa type at Mayo's discretion
Licence requirement: Fellows must obtain and maintain an appropriate medical licence while enrolled
Summary: A one-year UCNS-accredited clinical fellowship in headache and facial pain with nine core faculty and training in ultrasound-guided injections.

title: Multiple Sclerosis Fellowship

International applicants: Open to international applicants; graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification before appointment

title: Autoimmune Neurology Fellowship

Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)
Visa support: Mayo Clinic supports ECFMG J-1 and H-1B sponsorship (J-1 requires an ACGME-accredited/recognised programme; no new H-1B petitions requiring the US$100,000 payment); final visa type at Mayo's discretion
Licence requirement: Fellows must obtain and maintain an appropriate medical licence while enrolled
Summary: A one-year fellowship training academic neurologists in autoimmune neurology, covering idiopathic and paraneoplastic autoimmune neurological disorders with translational research opportunities.

title: Neurocritical Care Fellowship
Department: Department of Neurology, Mayo Clinic School of Graduate Medical Education
Deadline: March 15 of the year preceding the start date
International applicants: Open to international applicants; graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification before appointment
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited; eligible for UCNS or ABPN neurocritical care certification
Application method: SF Match Central Application Service; Neurocritical Care Fellowship Match (Neurocritical Care Society); interviews March–June
Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)
Visa support: Mayo Clinic supports ECFMG J-1 and H-1B sponsorship (J-1 requires an ACGME-accredited/recognised programme; no new H-1B petitions requiring the US$100,000 payment); final visa type at Mayo's discretion

title: Neuromuscular Medicine Fellowship

Deadline: AANEM Fellowship Portal opens to institutions March 1; interviews for 2027–2029 held April 2026; no offers before June 1

International applicants: Open to international applicants; graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification before appointment

Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)

Licence requirement: Fellows must obtain and maintain an appropriate medical licence while enrolled
Summary: A two-year programme of advanced training in the clinical diagnosis, electrodiagnosis, management and pathology of neuromuscular disorders for academic careers.

title: Clinical Neurophysiology (EEG) Fellowship
Department: Department of Neurology, Mayo Clinic School of Graduate Medical Education
Deadline: Early January of the year preceding the start date
Eligibility: Enrolled in or completed an accredited US neurology residency
International applicants: Open to international applicants; graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification before appointment
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited; eligible for ABPN clinical neurophysiology and ABCN certification
Application method: ERAS application with three letters of recommendation; NRMP Match
Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)

Licence requirement: Fellows must obtain and maintain an appropriate medical licence while enrolled
Summary: A one-year ACGME EEG fellowship covering EEG and prolonged recordings, surgical monitoring and cortical stimulation mapping with formal neurophysiology coursework.

title: NeuroOncology Fellowship
Department: Department of Neurology, Mayo Clinic School of Graduate Medical Education
Duration: 2 years (clinical year plus clinical or laboratory research year)
Eligibility: US citizen or permanent resident; completion of an accredited neurology residency (clinician-investigator track) or relevant doctoral degree (T32 position)
International applicants: No — US citizenship or permanent residency required
Application method: SF Match; Neuro-Oncology Match sponsored by the Society for Neuro-Oncology; interviews March–April
Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)
Licence requirement: Fellows must obtain and maintain an appropriate medical licence while enrolled
Summary: A two-year UCNS-accredited fellowship aligned with the Mayo Clinic Cancer Center NeuroOncology Program combining clinical training with clinical or laboratory research.
